3525-5475-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher does not have summoning sickness.
3525-5475-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
3525-5475-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat from step 1

969-985-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-4419-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-4419-4694-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

971-4289-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4289-4687.description:
Activate Cryptolith Rite by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2841-4862-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-4862-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Omnath and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Omnath trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3234-3293-5414-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5414-6495.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5414-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2169-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

573-1479-7885.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Synth Infiltrator each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-4785-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

713-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

5256-6602--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

116-1636-5371-7629.description:
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Hourglass of the Lost.
Repeat.
116-1636-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

2035-4067-7396.easyPrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
You control an additional creature.
2035-4067-7396.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gollum, untapping the permanent.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, returning Gollum from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-3835-7043.description:
Cast Aang either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{W}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

215-3464-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 5 life this turn.
215-3464-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
2034-6972-7234.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

700-3862-7046.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in hand.
700-3862-7046.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal nonlethal damage to Body of Knowledge after it is donated to an opponent.
700-3862-7046.description:
Donate Body of Knowledge to an opponent that has two or more cards in hand, then deal nonlethal damage to it.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing its controller to draw that many cards.
Orcish Bowmaster triggers for each card drawn. Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge and causing you to amass Orcs 1.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2292-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

141-5231-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5078-5645-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-5645-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4017-4186-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-4186-4506.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

687-4929-5641-6647.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{B} if Colonel Autumn is in your hand, or {3} if its in your graveyard
687-4929-5641-6647.notablePrerequisites: There are three removable counters on creatures you control if Colonel Autumn is in your graveyard.
687-4929-5641-6647.description:
Cast Colonel Autumn by paying {1}{W}{B} if its in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Colonel Autumn from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Colonel Autumn enters the battlefield, it triggers, exploiting itself and triggering its ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
687-4929-5641-6647.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo. This also will result in not gaining infinite +1/+1 counters.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

1995-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had five nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
1995-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least five charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array five times by removing five charge counters from it, adding {4}{W}.
Activate Gauntlets of Light by paying {2}{W}, untapping Tromell.
Repeat.

622-759-1247-5963-6549.description:
Activate Kamahl by paying {1}{G}, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1434-1486-1744-2972.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1434-1486-1744-2972.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

1308-2793-3743-4444-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3743-4444-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2061-2493-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2061-2493-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2757-3327.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2034-2757-3327.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dargo, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.
2034-2757-3327.notes: If you've sacrificed additional artifacts and/or creatures than specified, this combo nets infinite colorless mana and has no starting cost.

457-2538-2585-5390.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.
Repeat.

2038-4013-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2038-4013-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Kozilek's Predator.
When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2366-4677-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2835-4191-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

643-1789-2232-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-872-1373-2653-4482.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
224-872-1373-2653-4482.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Nissa and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to either tap or untap a creature, or scry 1.
Resolve the second Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

2060-2090-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least eight +1/+1 counters on it.
Bright-Palm does not have summoning sickness.
Bright-Palm and Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-2090-3398.description:
Declare Bright-Palm and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Bright-Palm trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

65-717-2628-2995-5181.description:
Activate Spara's Headquarters' cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Spara's Headquarters from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Spara's Headquarters ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

618-2062-4831.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Cacophodon with haste.
The Cacophodon token enters the battlefield, triggering Marauding Raptor, dealing 2 damage to the Cacophodon token and giving Marauding Raptor +2/+0 until end of turn.
The Cacophodon token triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
